criteria.criterion: The standalone workbench supports a layer tree, styles, labels, tables, filters, identify, selection, CRS handling, and measurement.
criteria.evidence: Retained actual compiled workbench journeys prove native hierarchy, continuous table filters, row selection, original Layer identities, navigation/identify, coordinate drawing and shared geographic measurement. Built Studio/API/PostgreSQL label-order/field/enabled controls, membership filters and layer-order/visibility survive Save/reopen; independent compiled native pixels prove labels. Normal-owner production composition proves pinned reusable Style, draw order, visibility, typed filters and fresh reopen. Declared CRS84/EPSG:4326/EPSG:3857 transforms/axis handling and safe spatial-body choices have separate exact retained acceptance.

criteria.criterion: Feature and attribute edits are durable, conflict-aware, versioned, and auditable.
criteria.evidence: Normal-owner concurrent deployed API clients update both Point geometry and name attributes through expected-version CAS: exactly one200/one409; immutable attributed histories retain base and winner with no losing revision. Independent native Modify/Snap applies governed PostGIS geometry and freshly reopens peer plus Studio/map/history with stable identities/properties; stale version rejects. These are real persistence/history receipts, not fixture-only durability.

Actual compiled Project device Save/fresh reopen retains exact Layer IDs, authored coordinates, saved measurement and independent GL camera; separate keyboard journey freshly reopens exact Project coordinates and backup. Real HTTP/PostgreSQL built Studio reopens label choices, membership filters, filter editor, layer order and visibility across two compositions; normal-owner production maps retain pinned Styles and exact saved presentation after latest Style advances. Native peer/Studio/history reopen verifies governed feature edits independently.

review.method: Read-only exact retained actual-workflow and hash review; no new tests, runtime, builds or cloud.
review.basis: All C01 advertised operation groups, C02 durable conflict-aware audited feature/attribute edits and C03 saved-state reopen have executable retained working-flow evidence. No concrete remaining original workflow blocker found.

limits: This is criterion-specific reuse of exact retained working flows at their original sources/environments; it is not a fresh run against every current mutable Workbench file.

Table/filter/identify/coordinate/measurement keyboard and Canvas journeys use synthetic loaded data, local device storage and blocked external network. They do not establish account authorization or deployment. Separate normal-owner production Style/CAS receipts provide the stated real persistence only.

Labels and membership filters have real local HTTP/PostgreSQL built-Studio Save/reopen and compiled worker/native-image acceptance. Production Style acceptance is an opaque LineString with labels disabled; broader deployed label/point/nonopaque portrayal remains unclaimed.
CRS handling is the declared CRS84/EPSG:4326/EPSG:3857 and safe body-boundary profile, not arbitrary projection registration or general coordinate migration.

General reshape/network topology, every expression/format/attachment, installed offline sync, full physical-device/OS-AT/multi-browser/representative-scale coverage, upstream desktop authoring exchange and clean-machine recovery are wider historical limits, not added original authoring criteria.
Historical failures and costs remain in their owning receipts; no committed write, browser journey or provider request is replayed by this reconciliation.
newExecution: Retained evidence/hash reconciliation only; no repeated workflow, build, cloud or deployment.
